interpretation: Visual review distinguishes moving localized Orbium-related candidates and distributed ring/stripe field patterns. Most retained candidates are distributed, often near-static patterns; retention count is not a count of new organisms.
followup: Keep separate archive space for localized active bodies, field patterns and transients. Broaden kernels/channels/initial generators instead of letting large mass or distributed texture dominate one score.
descriptors: Radial non-DC power is invariant to integer translations and quarter-turns (error <=3.89e-16); it is not a complete shape invariant. Late registered changes are relative L1 per 16 recorded updates, not physical speed or fitness.
